Welcome! This site collects the slides, reading material, and self-check quizzes for the Scientific English course.

Each session below has two parts:

- **Material** — the reading page, with vocabulary and key concepts explained.
- **Slides** — the in-class presentation (opens as a full-screen slideshow; press `f` for fullscreen, arrow keys to navigate, `s` for speaker notes).

At the end of most sessions you'll find a **live quiz**: scan the QR code with your phone to join and answer along with the rest of the class. All the quizzes and the classroom material are also collected on the [Quizzes & Material](quizzes.qmd) page.

Go to the [Sessions](sessions/index.qmd) page to get started.
